versions.changelog:
personwise-sales-enablement-training 2.1.9

- Updated workflow rules to explicitly require user approval for installing or updating the PersonWise CLI.
- Now honors only explicit user requests to use a non-default PersonWise market release.
- SKILL.md updated for clearer permission, CLI handling, and Skill invocation attribution instructions.
- Added Bash as an allowed tool and explicitly declared permissions.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

personwise-sales-enablement-training v2.1.8

- Updated SKILL.md for greater clarity on usage, workflow, and safety requirements.
- Strengthened instructions to only use approved, supplied source material; reinforced “no inventions” policy.
- Expanded CLI setup and update process documentation to ensure correct version alignment and software governance.
- Enhanced guidance on building interactive digital-human courses, including course structure and user interaction flow.
- Clarified attribution requirements and output formats for invoked skills.
